title: Platform registry and governed recovery
text: Governed Postgres models live on an environment box without retired cloud coordinates; box is the only environment database.location. Box db-admin setup needs only the model database_name, the provisioned DSN file and the environment's servers[0] mac_host, mac_host_ssh_key_path and mac_host_key_fingerprint: it writes its own SSH hop through that Mac host to ~/.yoke/ssh/config, pinning the Mac host's key only when its fingerprint matches, creates and authorizes the operator key and pins the VM host key, and never edits ~/.ssh/config.
